novelty_search.nearest_result: The v4 design-seen screen fit four affine coefficients on A1 root alphas and passed v4 A2/P/C, but has not been tested on a new lexicon.
novelty_search.new_question: Do the identical four coefficients predict selective q_is actuation on a fifth disjoint lexicon under capability-first validation?

prospective_boundary.scope: Fifth lexicon within the registered this/that-moment constructions, not unrestricted syntax OOD.

capability_policy.provenance: Unchanged from the valid v4 root-actuator authority.
capability_policy.A_P_cells: For each family and direction, pooled base+donor native accuracy >=0.85.
capability_policy.C_cells: For each direction, pooled base+donor native accuracy >=0.75.

frozen_program.actuator: alpha = frozen intercept + slope * exact local current-minus-other is/was margin at resid:10; write resid:18_source + alpha*q_is. No root search, donor activation, confirmation final margin, row ID, or outcome selects alpha.

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_capability_a: All authority, disjointness, capability, basis, and exact local/final head controls pass.
predictions.pred_b_frozen_upstream_program: All 64 finite alphas equal the frozen affine program and use no forbidden input.
predictions.pred_c_new_lexicon_A_prediction: A1 and A2 each have mean recovery >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_new_lexicon_P_generalization: P mean reflection >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: 64 unique records in exactly two model forwards/128 examples, zero root/grid/backwards/updates, and four inherited parameters.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: frozen q_is read-compute-write program predicts a prospective disjoint lexicon.
terminal.null: Authority/program/coverage pass but A/P prediction or C selectivity misses.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, head, basis, program identity, or coverage fails.
